title: 第25章 激战第26章 制空权的重要性
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
戌时。
随夕阳的沉落，天色逐渐暗了。
唐宜年父子准时出现在了院落。
他们刚接近小楼，便隐隐约约的看到宋文从药田之中走了出来。
唐宜年脸上堆起笑意，“以前只听闻，极阴长老收了一位少年俊杰为徒，今日一见，果然气宇轩昂，人中龙凤。”
宋文并不认得唐宜年，他面露疑惑的道，“您是？”
与其父子的热忱不同，唐梁的脸色却是有些阴冷，
他与宋文之间本就有怨，现在宋文又已经学会了仙法火球术，这让唐梁心中忿忿不平。
一个不知道哪里冒出来的乡野小子，竟然三月不到，就得到了他梦寐以求的东西，这不得不让唐梁心中满是嫉妒。
他盯着宋文，带着几分讥讽道。
“你身为天煞帮弟子，竟然不认得帮主。”
宋文闻言心中一惊，唐宜年的出现是在他意料之外的，传言中，唐宜年可是江湖上少有的高手。
今日的谋划不会有意外吧？
不过在想到自己的那些布置后，宋文又放下心来。
宋文内心思绪万千，脸上却是不动声色。而且还浮现出受宠若惊的笑容，双手抱拳说道。
“晚辈宋文，见过帮主。”
“帮主过誉了，晚辈可当不起您的称赞。”
“师尊正在房中等两位，两位快请吧。”
唐宜年点了点头，“有空的时候，宋贤侄可要多到我府上走动。”
说完，便带着唐梁，往小楼而去。

待到走远之后，唐宜年低声问自己儿子道。
“你和他有前嫌？”
唐梁回道，“发生过一点不愉快的事情。”
唐宜年道，“最好能与之和解，依我看来，此子城府颇深，加之学会了仙人法术，将来不是泛泛之辈。”
唐宜年不知晓的是，两人已经是死仇。
...
宋文望着两人背影，嘴角浮现一抹嗜血笑意。
他为今晚击杀唐梁，已经做好了所有准备。
刚刚他之所以会出现在药田之中，是他趁着夜色，去将灵田中的赤血藤给连根拔了出来，装入玉盒，放入了储物袋之中。
所有准备都已万事俱备，现在只剩请君入瓮。
当看到两人上了二楼，宋文便开始默默运转灵力，为释放火球术而做好准备。
content_en:
Xu Shi.
As the sun sets, the sky gradually gets darker.
Tang Yinian and his son appeared in the courtyard on time.
As soon as they approached the small building, they vaguely saw Song Wen walking out of the medicine field.
A smile appeared on Tang Yinian's face, "I had only heard before that Elder Jiyin had accepted a handsome young man as his disciple. When I saw him today, he was indeed very majestic and one of the best among men."
Song Wen didn't recognize Tang Yinian. He asked with confusion, "Who are you?"
Different from the enthusiasm of father and son, Tang Liang's face was a little cold.
There was already a grudge between him and Song Wen, and now Song Wen had learned the immortal fireball technique, which made Tang Liang feel resentful.
A country boy who appeared out of nowhere got what he had dreamed of in less than three months, which had to make Tang Liang full of jealousy.
He stared at Song Wen and said with a bit of sarcasm.
"As a disciple of the Tiansha Clan, you don't recognize the leader."
Song Wen was shocked when he heard this. Tang Yinian's appearance was unexpected. According to rumors, Tang Yinian was a rare master in the world.
There won’t be any surprises in today’s plan, right?
However, after thinking about his arrangements, Song Wen felt relieved again.
Song Wen had a lot of thoughts in his heart, but his face was calm. He also showed a flattered smile and said with his hands clasped in fists.
"Junior Song Wen has met the gang leader."
"The gang leader has given you too much praise. This junior cannot bear your praise."
"Master is waiting for you two in the room. Please invite us quickly."
Tang Yinian nodded, "Nephew Song Xian should come to my house more often when he is free."
After saying that, he took Tang Liang and went to the small building.
After walking far away, Tang Yinian asked his son in a low voice.
"You have a history with him?"
Tang Liang replied, "Something unpleasant happened."
Tang Yinian said, "It's best to reconcile with him. In my opinion, this son has a profound knowledge of the city. In addition, he has learned the magic of immortals, so he will not be an ordinary person in the future."
What Tang Yinian didn't know was that the two were already mortal enemies.
...
Song Wen looked at the backs of the two of them, a bloodthirsty smile appearing on the corner of his mouth.
He has made all preparations to kill Tang Liang tonight.
The reason why he appeared in the medicine field just now was that he took advantage of the night to uproot the red blood vine in the spiritual field, put it into a jade box, and put it into a storage bag.
All preparations have been made, and now all that remains is to invite you into the urn.
When he saw the two people going up to the second floor, Song Wen began to silently use his spiritual power to prepare for the release of the fireball technique.
